mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.user_id AS userId, s.medication_id AS medicationId, s.prescription_id AS prescriptionId, s.cabinet_id AS cabinetId, s.routine_id AS routineId, NVL(m.item_name, NVL(rm.supplement_name, '약품')) AS name, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, CASE WHEN s.prescription_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'prescription' WHEN s.routine_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'supplement' WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'regular' ELSE 'prescription' END AS type, TO_CHAR(s.taken_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS takenAt, NVL(s.alarm_enabled, 1) AS alarmEnabled, CASE WHEN s.alarm_enabled = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isCancelled FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id LEFT JOIN routine_medications rm ON s.routine_id = rm.routine_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC

SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId", item_name AS "itemName" FROM medications WHERE item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ROWNUM <= 15
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cabinet_medications ( user_id, medication_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{medicationId}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO routine_medications ( user_id, supplement_name, take_time, notes, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{supplementName}, #{takeTime}, '캘린더 등록', 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET scheduled_at = TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || #{newTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), alarm_enabled = NVL(#{alarmEnabled}, 1) WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules ( user_id, medication_id, prescription_id, routine_id, cabinet_id, scheduled_at, alarm_enabled, taken_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{medicationId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prescriptionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{routineId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cabinetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_DATE(#{scheduledDate} || ' ' || #{scheduledTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), NVL(#{alarmEnabled}, 1), NULL )
